v004_fit_test.why_not_v005: the v005 ZIP (6,707,841 bytes) exceeds the Drive connector's transfer size; v004 is the newest set that could be brought into the sandbox. Re-check v005 locally.
v004_fit_test.result: desk, filing cabinet, typewriter, rotary phone, desk lamp and wall clock placed at the X14 sockets in both demo rooms with no collisions after aligning the sockets to the I09 contract (renders *_i09_*).
i09_findings_for_owner: Axis: I09 GLBs (trimesh exporter) store height on glTF +Z with an unrotated root, but glTF is +Y up by spec, so Blender and UE import every piece lying on its back. Previews correct it with a -90° X rotation; the I09 files were not modified.
Desk LOD0 lowest point is z 0.02 m: the desk floats 2 cm above its pivot unless glides are added or the pivot moves.
